verdict.rationale: Asking whether customer data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud platform that hosts customer data and offers AI services, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing about data-usage policy, training opt-outs, or AI data-handling commitments: it covers only the CLI, infrastructure-as-code, RBAC, cost management and outages. With no evidence of this capability, the verdict is none.
